headline: Start Center and in-workspace switcher project the same M5 entry-target classes, trust, restore, and missing-root truth.

restore_vocabulary.label: Exact restore
restore_vocabulary.definition: The same object identity and session state can be restored without translation.

restore_vocabulary.label: Compatible restore
restore_vocabulary.definition: The same object identity can be restored after a declared compatible translation or rebind.

restore_vocabulary.label: Layout only
restore_vocabulary.definition: Window, pane, or editor layout can be restored, but live session state cannot.

restore_vocabulary.label: Recovered drafts
restore_vocabulary.definition: Dirty buffers or drafts can be recovered without claiming a full session restore.

restore_vocabulary.label: Evidence only
restore_vocabulary.definition: Evidence can be exported or inspected, but not replayed as active state.

restore_vocabulary.label: No restore
restore_vocabulary.definition: No restorable state is available for this entry.
